decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent with counterspells and removal while putting pressure on them with efficient, evasive creatures. The key strategy is to control the game tempo by protecting your threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan. Cards like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early aggression, while Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher. The deck uses a mix of cantrips and card selection to find the right answers at the right time. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive yet controlling playstyle.

The deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off, using various mana accelerants to cast a series of spells that win the game on the spot. The key combo pieces are Wild Cantor, Thassa's Oracle, and Undercity Informer/Balustrade Spy to mill the entire library and win the game with the Oracle's ability. The deck also includes protection in the form of Pact of Negation and Leyline of Anticipation, and ways to recur combo pieces with Dread Return. The deck is all in on the combo, with minimal interaction or backup plans.

This deck focuses on maintaining tempo and aggression by leveraging cheap and efficient spells to control the board while quickly deploying threats. Utilizing a mix of disruptive spells like Force of Will and Lightning Bolt, along with powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to quickly pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The deck also includes card selection and card advantage engines like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration to ensure consistency and smooth draws. Additionally, utilizing versatile lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary offers additional utility.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. It also utilizes efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the opponent's board. The deck aims to maintain tempo by utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the right answers at the right time. Additionally, the deck includes some card advantage with Expressive Iteration and Predict to outvalue the opponent. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

The primary focus of this deck is to assemble the Cephalid Breakfast combo using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, followed by Dread Return targeting Thassa's Oracle for a win condition. The deck also includes various ways to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds consistency and value to the deck, allowing for more flexibility in gameplay and additional resources.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the tempo of the game by utilizing efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, supported by disruptive spells like Force of Will and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal, all backed up by card selection and manipulation through Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration. Additionally, the inclusion of Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base, further increasing the deck's tempo advantage.

The main concept of this UR Tempo deck is to utilize low-cost, efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to pressure the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to maintain tempo advantage by constantly deploying threats and protecting them, while also using cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to manage the board and finish off the opponent swiftly. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive strategy, with a focus on fetching for dual lands and utility lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary.

The key concept of this deck is to establish early aggression and tempo control by utilizing low-cost spells and efficient creatures to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while maintaining card advantage through card selection effects like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration. By quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, the deck seeks to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while also providing disruption with cards like Wasteland.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor combo to mill the library, then play Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. It utilizes various control elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Baleful Strix for additional value and interaction. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a powerful companion option to provide additional utility and flexibility in longer games.

This Dragon Stompy deck focuses on putting early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Bonecrusher Giant, backed up by disruption in the form of Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere. By utilizing fast mana sources like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's spells and mana base while quickly deploying threats. Blood Moon and Shatterskull Smashing provide additional disruption and reach, allowing the deck to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their game plan using cards like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex. The deck aims to have a fast start with cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal, while also providing card advantage and consistency through Seasoned Dungeoneer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck uses a mix of white and colorless mana sources, including lands like Caves of Chaos Adventurer and Ancient Tomb, to power out its threats quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on playing powerful disruptive creatures and using fast mana to establish an early board presence. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like White Plume Adventurer and Lion Sash to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands and equipment to further enhance its game plan of putting pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive in order to win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to establish board presence quickly through efficient creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper and Archon of Emeria, while disrupting opponents with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Chancellor of the Annex. The deck aims to maintain aggressive pressure and control the board with key lands like Karakas and Cavern of Souls. By utilizing fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox, the deck can deploy threats early and overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggro and disruptive elements.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost evasive creatures with the ability to deal damage whenever they connect with the opponent. By utilizing cards like Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow and Changeling Outcast, the goal is to consistently deal damage to the opponent while also disrupting their plays with counterspells like Force of Will. The deck aims to quickly close out the game by leveraging the card advantage provided by Yuriko's ability and the synergy between Ninjas and other evasive creatures in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Show and Tell. By cheating big threats like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play early on, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures that can quickly win the game. The combination of combo pieces and graveyard manipulation allows for explosive plays and a fast-paced game plan that can be difficult for opponents to stop in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly, mainly through the use of Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond. The deck then aims to assemble the necessary pieces for a powerful combo turn, utilizing cards like Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, and Infernal Tutor to generate even more mana and find key combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own combo. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, explosive combos to win the game.
